title: Blotter: A drifting dock piling, a bust on the beach and a messy car-handle mystery - NewsBreak
text:
By Chris Francescani ,
19 hours ago From a drifting dock piling in Mattituck to a driver allegedly racing through Greenport’s school zone before being apprehended hiding on an East Marion beach, this week’s Southold Town Police blotter features the mundane, the messy and the mildly mysterious. Officers also fielded reports of a late-night chase among young men in Greenport, a unlocked car entered overnight and a briefcase stolen, a neighbor dispute tied to a proposed chicken farm — and an unusual harassment complaint involving something unpleasant left on a pair of car door handles.
